district_attorney_office.description: Handles felony prosecutions, grand jury preparation, and major trial work for the 27th Judicial District.
district_attorney_office.selection_method: Elected by voters of Bell County (4-year terms).

personnel.name: Stephanie Newell
personnel.title: District Attorney (Current)
personnel.experience: Took office in January 2025 after winning the 2024 election. Defeated Jeff Parker in the Republican primary.

personnel.name: Henry L. Garza
personnel.title: District Attorney (Former)
personnel.experience: Served as District Attorney for 23 years across 6 terms. Previously prosecuted misdemeanors in the County Attorney's office from 1983-1986.

county_attorney_office.description: Handles misdemeanor prosecutions, juvenile justice cases, and advises county officials.
county_attorney_office.selection_method: Elected by voters of Bell County (4-year terms).

personnel.name: James E. Nichols
personnel.title: County Attorney (Current)
personnel.experience: Current Bell County Attorney. Oversees misdemeanor and juvenile prosecutions.

personnel.name: James Vernon "Jim" Murphy
personnel.title: Assistant County Attorney, Juvenile Prosecutor
personnel.experience: Over 30 years in the legal field, with a primary focus on juvenile law, criminal, and administrative law. Has served as a juvenile prosecutor in Bell County for approximately 18 years. Participates in Youth Sequential Intercept Model Mapping workshops to improve juvenile justice outcomes.

personnel.name: Sandra Hunt
personnel.title: Investigator / Complainant
personnel.experience: Serves as an investigator for the Bell County Attorney's Office. Often acts as the 'Complainant' on court dockets, meaning she signs the formal complaint or affidavit of probable cause that initiates criminal proceedings based on her investigations. Previously served as a Sergeant and Detective with the Killeen Police Department (Property Crimes, Gang Unit, Organized Crime). Received the Wilroy Pitrucha Award in 2006 from the Bell County DA for excellence in criminal investigations.

courts.description: The Bell County courts, including County Courts at Law (misdemeanors/juvenile) and District Courts (felonies), where these prosecutors file cases and litigate. Check the official county site for judicial schedules.

criminal_defense_attorneys_directory.description: Directory of private criminal defense attorneys available to practice in Bell County, Texas. These attorneys represent defendants in criminal cases against the Bell County public prosecutors.
